answer: Each agent enrolls one jade shard, a hardware fingerprint sealed at attestation. Each epoch the ocean beacon publishes a swell pattern, and the agent must answer wrapped in a fable seal, a story hash of shard, swell, and epoch words. Sixty clones on one machine share one shard, so all seals match. The first is kept, 59 are rejected and slashed 450 POA each. Faking 60 agents costs 60 devices at $110 each, 120,000 POA in stake, and 300 hours of setup. Like a harbor where each ship flies a jade figurehead carved from its own keel, sixty copies of one figurehead give the forgery away.
